purpose: Determinate or indeterminate progress with a required accessible task label.
behaviorProvider: ARIA progressbar with normalized host-provided numeric progress.

component: Use a positive finite max or default to 100. Clamp finite value into zero through max; omitted/non-finite value is indeterminate.
Expose label, min, max and actual normalized value on the progressbar. Omit aria-valuenow for indeterminate progress and use a token-backed indeterminate fill width.
host: Provide a meaningful task label and truthful progress units.
Own operation start/end/error state; an intent color does not set completion or execute work.

requirements.statement: Use a positive finite max or default to 100. Clamp finite value into zero through max; omitted/non-finite value is indeterminate.
Expose label, min, max and actual normalized value on the progressbar. Omit aria-valuenow for indeterminate progress and use a token-backed indeterminate fill width.
Optional visible percentage is rounded from value/max and hidden from assistive technology to avoid duplicating the progressbar name/value.
Provide a meaningful task label and truthful progress units.
Own operation start/end/error state; an intent color does not set completion or execute work.

Use feedback group tokens for owned presentation, preserve genuine nested component ownership, and verify the same geometry across Fundamental and Fundamental Floating in light/dark. Keep the documented semantics and state model when composing or extending this family.

limitations: No progress estimation, live task monitoring or success/error lifecycle is implemented.
Authored source coverage is separate from executed interaction, visual, accessibility and consumer-package evidence.
